verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing documents first-party project planning: it says you can 'organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks', 'create issues and manage projects', and manage projects from mobile. None of these items mentions a kanban board, columns, or moving cards between statuses, so the board-specific part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of kanban/board views with configurable columns, docs on card/status workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
